svg.text: McCzarny recently pushed several commits across
his projects. In chromium-daily-digest, he
added a GitHub Actions workflow for
documentation deployment and refactored
chromiumService.ts to improve concurrent API
requests and prevent rate limiting. He also
enhanced the web interface with local storage
for last read date, keyboard navigation, and
updated the Gemini model to 3.7-flash. For
dcvis, McCzarny introduced a "Power Scale" tab
to compare Data Center power consumption
against power plant blocks. He updated water
usage data to reflect public declarations,
separating direct and total consumption with
visual map representations, and integrated
groundwater productivity information. A new
"Energy" layer was added, enabling comparison
of the Data Center's annual energy consumption
with the city of Bełchatów. He also
simplified the noise analysis UI to
simultaneously display neutral and wind
inversion conditions. In crater-js, he added a
"Cilia Hauler" helper mob, redesigned unity
bonuses and their UI, and implemented basic
impatience.
